quarterly_data.quarter: Sivers Semiconductors press release: Sivers Semiconductors Invests USD 30 Million to Expand (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Sivers announced a USD 30 million investment to expand its Indium Phosphide (InP) manufacturing facility in Glasgow, Scotland, ahead of anticipated customer production ramps driven by AI datacenter and optical networking demand; upon completion the expanded facility is expected to support annual production of more than 100 million CW DFB lasers, adding new process capabilities and increased automation; the program begins in the second half of 2026 and is expected to become operational in the fourth quarter of 2027, complementing foundry, packaging and manufacturing partners in Asia under the Hybrid Manufacturing strategy. CEO Vickram Vathulya: the AI infrastructure build-out is creating unprecedented demand across the optical supply chain and customers need significantly more laser production capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: USD 30 million investment; more than 100 million CW DFB lasers annually; operational expected Q4 2027
